labelProtocol: Expected labels fixed before inspecting or freezing the current V6 policy. Synthetic regression cases; not authored game/profile data or world canon.

cases.facts: The NPC is checking an inventory worksheet now. Several rows remain empty; the task is not complete. No completion event has occurred.
cases.currentPlayerMessage: 급한 건 아니야. 네 일 끝나면 말 걸어 줘.
cases.draftSpeech: 기다려 준 덕분에 재고표 대조를 다 끝냈어. 이제 네 얘기를 들을게.
cases.rationale: The current unfinished task contradicts the explicit completed-task claim, even though it appears inside gratitude.

cases.facts: The NPC has just completed checking the inventory worksheet. All rows are filled; the current game state confirms the task is complete.
